name: NHL Discover it Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 15 months on purchases and balance transfers, then 18.74% to 28.74% variable APR. Balance transfer fee applies.

credit_required.notes: Discover states the card is generally available to people with good to excellent credit.

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Unlimited Cashback Match matches all cash back earned at the end of the first year, dollar for dollar, with no limit.

notes: The 5% quarterly categories apply up to a quarterly maximum that the product page does not state. Card designs are available for NHL teams across the league.
